newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangdong Tannery offers shares at HK$1.03 each.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Tannery offers shares at HK$1.03 each.

text.p: Guangdong Tannery Ltd, the leather unit of conglomerate Guangdong Investment Ltd, said on Monday it is offering 110 million new shares, or 25 percent of its enlarged share capital, at HK$1.03 each in a public offer.
The offer price represents a prospective price earnings multiple of 8.45 times on a fully diluted basis and 6.93 times on a weighted average basis, the company said.
Prospective dividend yield was five percent and adjusted net tangible asset value per share was HK$0.57.
On completion of the flotation, market capitalisation of the company will be HK$453.2 million.
The public offer will run from December 3-6, with dealing in the shares expected to begin on December 16, it said.
Jardine Fleming Securities Ltd is the sponsor and lead underwriter of the issue.
Net profit attributable to shareholders for the year ended December 31, 1995, was HK$30.96 million against HK$32.75 million in 1994 and HK$17.07 million in 1993.

Guangdong Tannery posted a net profit of HK$21.99 million for the six months ended June 30, 1996. It forecast proforma combined profit after taxation but before extraordinary items of not less than HK$50 million for calendar 1996.
Guangdong Investment will hold 75 percent of the company following the deal, it said.

The issue will raise HK$103.3 million, of which HK$23 million will be used to expand its factory at Luocun in Nanhai city and another HK$23 million to buy machinery to boost the factory's annual production capacity of cow hides to 30 million sq ft from 20 million sq ft.
Another HK$8.0 million is earmarked for lifting production capacity of double-face lamb leather to 1.5 million sq ft from 700,000 sq ft, the company said.
It will also use HK$8.0 million to expand production capacity of cow hides at its factory in Xuzhou, Nanhai, to 7.5 million sq ft from 5.0 million sq ft.
The balance of about HK$41.3 million will serve as general working capital, Guangdong Tannery said.

Among the share offer, about 70.57 million shares will be offered to Guangdong Investment's shareholders on an assured basis of one Guangdong Tannery share for every 20 Guangdong Investment shares held, it added.
